title: Cartas: Vice City Manatees
sum: 24 cartas de futebol americano, com o local de cada uma.
body:
- Futebol americano, 24 cartas. Locais segundo a lista da IGN; marque cada uma ao pegar.
- 2 carta(s) ficam em **cofre**: abra com o código que sai do assalto àquele lugar ou com sticky bomb.
- Volte para [[colecao-cartas]].

No balcão da garagem rosa da villa creme grande na Neptune Cir, beira-mar oeste de Vespucci Island
Dentro de uma revista ao lado do vaso num postinho no pântano, oeste de Pelican Valley
Na lateral da geladeira do apartamento central com cestos de roupa na porta, 2º andar do New Avalon, NE 10th St, nordeste de Crosstown
No canto da prateleira do depósito da Wash House (entra pelo buraco no telhado), SR-27, noroeste de Belville
No cofre da sala dos fundos do 247 da Indigo St x Atlantic Ave, Ocean Beach (código vem do assalto a esse 247)
Embaixo da placa de tartaruga na parede, na boca de tubarão da sala de exposição do Vice City Oceanarium, Catalan Key
Numa mesa no fim de um corredor de um prédio modular numa obra perto do Nehrling River, North Mariana
No pátio de cima, entre duas cadeiras de praia, da casa no píer no meio da baía, nordeste de Corsair Key
Num pedaço de madeira na parede da garagem separada de uma casa azul-clara logo a oeste de Ambrosia
Na lateral da geladeira de uma casa amarela à beira-mar na Surfside Dr, leste de Key Lento
Na borda do topo do tanque d'água grande, sob o gradil, ao lado do estádio do Capri City Jackals, sudeste de Capri
No gradil do canto sudoeste do telhado do estacionamento ao lado do Fleeca Field, Rockridge
No canto de um pôster apoiado no chão nos fundos da garagem de uma villa creme grande na Rialto Cswy, Casanova Island
No canto de um pôster apoiado no chão nos fundos da garagem de uma villa creme grande na Rialto Cswy, Casanova Island (mesmo local da Dusty Pink, segundo a IGN)
No pátio lateral de um condomínio, ao lado da porta de correr, no centro da Mamey Cir, sul de Waning Sands
Numa estante ao lado da copa, em frente à sala de ginástica junto ao saguão do Grand Majestic Aparthotel, Tequesta
Na segunda prateleira de baixo de uma estante sob o telheiro da casa velha na beira da SR-45, Grayson

Embaixo de um banco na passarela elevada entre o Fleeca Field e a estação Manatees Stadium Central Line, Rockridge

en.title: Cards: Vice City Manatees
en.body:
- Football, 24 cards. Locations from IGN's list; tick each one as you grab it.
- 2 card(s) sit in a **safe**: open it with the code from robbing that place, or a sticky bomb.
- Back to [[colecao-cartas]].

check.d: On the wall next to the calendar in the living room of a yellow house on NW 12th St in central La Perle
On the counter of the pink garage in the large creme villa on Neptune Cir on the western waterfront of Vespucci Island
Inside of a magazine next to the toilet on a small swamp outpost in western Pelican Valley
On the side of a fridge in the kitchen of the center apartment with the clothes baskets out front on the second floor of the New Avalon Apartment complex on NE 10th St in northeastern Crosstown
On the corner of the shelf in the storage room of the Wash House, accessible via the hole in the roof, on SR-27 in northwestern Belville
Inside the safe in the back room of the 247 on the corner of Indigo St and Atlantic Ave in Ocean Beach. This requires a unique safe combination from robbing the 247
Underneath the turtle sign on the wall in the shark mouth of the live exhibiting room of the Vice City Oceanarium in Catalan Key
On top of a desk at the end of a hallway in a modular building on a construction site near the Nehrling River in North Mariana County
On the upper patio between two lawn chairs of the house on the dock in the middle of the bay in the northeastern section of Corsair key
On top of a piece of wood on the wall of the detached garage of a light blue house to the west just outside of Ambrosia
On the side of a fridge in the kitchen of a yellow waterfront house on Surfside Dr in eastern Key Lento
On the edge on top of the large water tank underneath the railing next to the Capri City Jackals stadium in southeastern Capri
On top of the railing in the southwestern corner of the roof of the parking garage next to Fleeca Field in Rockridge
On the corner of a poster resting on the ground in the back of the garage of a large creme villa on Rialto Cswy on Casanova Island
On the corner of a poster resting on the ground in the back of the garage of a large creme villa on Rialto Cswy on Casanova Island
On the side patio of a condo next to the sliding door in the center of Mamey Cir in southern Waning Sands
In a bookshelf next to the kitchenette across from the Fitness Room next to the lobby in the Grand Majestic Aparthotel in Tequesta
On the second shelf from the bottom of a shelving unit in the open overhang attached to the aged house on the side of SR-45 in Grayson
On the side of a corkboard in the entryway into the Overkeel Boatyard & Marina on the eastern coast of East Lummox County
On top of a middle shelf in the corner of the back office in a white house on Reservoir St in northeastern Ambrosia near Lake Leonida
Inside a safe on top of a filling cabinet in the southernmost storage unit near the beach in southern Ocean Beach
On an electrical box on top of a radio tower above the Vital Lines Telecommunications building off of Reservoir St in northern Ambrosia
On the side of a corkboard of a modular building in a construction site leading to the Pay 'N' Spray off of Riverbend Rd in southern West Vice-Dale County
Underneath a bench in the above-ground walkway between Fleeca Field and Manatees Stadium Central Line Train Station in Rockridge
